agencyId.description: Agency id of the mentioned user. Only for an agency end client.

agencyUserId.description: Agency user id of the mentioned user. Only for an agency end client.

deleted.description: True when the mentioned account no longer exists. A user that merely lost access to the brand is not deleted: their mention keeps rendering as it always did.

name.description: Current display name of the mentioned user. Absent when the account was deleted, in which case the frontend renders its own localized deleted-user label.

userId.description: Regular user id of the mentioned user. Absent for an agency end client.

profilePicture.description: Public URL of the author's 400x400 profile picture. Absent when they have none, in which case the frontend renders its initials fallback. Filled for agency-authored notes too.

dateTime.description: Local Date-time represented with a certain timezone
